Proposed tools
Planned: Node.js crypto · HTTP-only cookies · Rate limiting
THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

Auth is easy to get dangerously wrong: weak hashing, leaky error messages, missing rate limits.

DESIGN APPROACH

Approach

Planned with Node’s crypto.scrypt for hashing, HTTP-only cookies for sessions and the rate limiter already in this repo.

Key features

  • 01Sign-up and login
  • 02Password reset flow
  • 03Session management
  • 04Rate-limited endpoints
